name: Unidentified BX-series droid commando (Parlin)
description: A BX-series droid commando was a BX-series droid who served Mistress Cellia Moten during the Imperial Era. During or after 18 BBY, the droid was destroyed while on a mission to the planet Tryth by the Sith Lord Darth Vader.

data.name: Unidentified BX-series droid commando
data.death: During or after 18 BBY, Moten yacht, Tryth
